_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-07 · SkyMiner — both your decisions plus all four follow-ups are live. Sierra is on the governance register, the drift detector is built, and the save button takes one click now.
_status: Everything you decided today is shipped. Sierra now never hides a fact to be polite: if your college hasn't set up credit for something, she says so, says who HAS set it up, says the nearest college that actually teaches it (however far — she'll tell you the distance and let you judge), and if truly nobody offers it she says that plainly and offers to put the gap on record rather than inventing something. Live as v35. On governance: you were right that Sierra wasn't on the register at all — she is now, with three new rows, and the drift detector you asked for is built and runs daily. It found 39 things, filtered to 15 worth reading; six of them are recurring jobs nobody had listed. No register row points at anything that's disappeared. Your save-button bug turned out to be three bugs, and in all three the data was actually saved correctly — only the screen was wrong, which is the kind nobody can report accurately. Two of the others would have been worse: one made every owner vanish whenever a read hiccuped, which looks exactly like someone deleting them. Seven smaller ones are written up but not fixed; the one you'd hit first is Clear-owner doing nothing on three of the cadences, which will look like the same bug coming back. It isn't.

items.text: 📬 SEVEN FEEDBACK REPORTS STILL NEED YOU — the inbox is cleaned up (our test robot's 31 rows are filtered out of the queue and the counts, and 4 reports whose fixes have shipped are marked done). The most useful of what's left: someone asked how many colleges have a CPL counsellor listed and Sierra couldn't answer, though she names them one at a time — that's a build, not a bug. Two are data gaps you already know about (student counts per certificate). The rest need an eye: Modesto showing 75 early-childhood credit recommendations when its landing page shows 4; Sierra reading the Fullerton catalogue in one answer and not the next; a bare thumbs-down on College of the Canyons; and the 17 July 'I don't have a college yet' report, which the student-portal work probably fixed but nobody has confirmed. ⚠ Please don't invite the MAP and CO teams until this has an owner — it's now CA-06 on the ⚖️ Governance tab, and that tab will show you the untriaged count live.

🔗 STILL UNCHECKED: THE LINK SIERRA GIVES STUDENTS — creditforbeingyou.org/main/student. I can't reach that domain from here, so it has never been confirmed and it's now in front of every student who asks. One click tells us; it's a one-line fix if it's wrong.

🔍 FINISH THE POACHING AUDIT — now that the 'never hide facts, never sell' line is live, re-run the five-part review (Sierra's rule text, her per-audience voices, the context builders, the live guidance rows in the 🧭 pane, and the sibling report generators) to confirm nothing else still tells her to stay quiet. SkyHero's audit was still running when that session ended and was never reported.

📚 REFRESH SIERRA'S EXHIBIT LIST — unchanged and still the biggest limit. Her copy covers 2,397 exhibits across 59 colleges; MAP has 123, and her college profiles were last refreshed 25 June. American River, LA Mission and West LA all give CPR credit and she cannot see them. Touches a shared table production reads, so walk Sam through the impact first.

🔢 WIRE MALONE'S STUDENT×CREDIT-RECOMMENDATION VIEW into the funding backlog builder once the view name lands. The 11.8MB export could not be read directly (the Drive connector caps at 10MB). Agreed columns are the 8 non-identifying ones; Sam wants small-group suppression at fewer than 10.

🧪 SIERRA STILL SKIPS THE NEAREST TEACHING COLLEGE — the one thing from today that isn't finished. Asked about carpentry at LA Harbor she names the colleges that award the credit (~50 mi) but not Rio Hondo or LA Trade Tech, which teach it right there. We know the data exists because she lists exactly those colleges when the same question is asked a different way. Next session measures WHY before changing anything — the two possible causes need opposite fixes and guessing has cost this workstream weeks before.

⚖️ FOUR GOVERNANCE ROWS NEED AN OWNER — DR-11 (who decides what Sierra tells the public — so far that's been you personally, four times in two days), CA-06 (Sierra feedback triage, which shows its own untriaged count live), OQ-07 (what must be true before inviting the MAP and CO teams) and OQ-08 (how new surfaces get onto the register at all). The ⚖️ tab now also shows a '🔎 Not on the register' strip — 15 things the daily scan found, six of them recurring jobs nobody listed. They're proposals; nothing gets added without you.

⚠️ HEADS-UP, NOT A BUG YOU NEED TO REPORT — 'Clear owner' does nothing on three cadences (the daily dashboard, the users sync, and the checkpoint loop), because those carry an owner in the register file itself rather than an assigned one. It'll look exactly like the two-click save bug coming back. It isn't, it's already written up, and it's on the list to fix.
